judged_text: parseRefreshTokenResponse returns the raw Zod safeParse wrapper ({success, data}) while this call site persists that wrapper directly as credential.key, replacing the previous googleCredentialSchema.parse() which returned the parsed data. On the first token refresh (default, non-sharing mode), prisma stores {success:true, data:{...}} as the Google credential key; the next time the credential is loaded, googleCredentialSchema.parse(credential.key) fails because access_token/refresh_token now live one level down, so every Google Calendar availability check and booking throws until the user re-connects — stored credentials are corrupted.
